subject: memory-ecosystem
intent: The Memory Master Explainer describes a single memory system in which content enters through five distinct write paths into two storage layers (a mirror layer written by sync, ungated, and a durable layer written only through the Memory Governor's gate), and questions are answered through two independent read mechanisms (GBrain's hybrid search and Graphify's deterministic parsing). The load-bearing claim the drawing must make a reader trust: the mirror is written un-gated because its authority is fidelity to existing files, while the durable layer is gated because it alone claims to be believed - and the governed spine (submit -> gate -> verify -> write) is the one path that confers durable status.
type_reason: Component ecosystem with five write flows and two read flows; architecture forgives many edges and supports trust boundaries, where dataflow's strict grid punished dense crossing flows.

node_roles.gbrain-store: one store, two badges: mirror layer / durable layer

deferred_to_cards: PDLF step-completion writer (Path 3): same gate, own credential, parked
